name: Clutch
summary: B2B services marketplace — submit a free project brief and get matched with verified, best-fit agencies for your project, no research required.
best_for: businesses that want to skip manual agency research and get matched quickly with vetted, best-fit service providers for a specific project
skip_if: you already have trusted agency relationships, or you'd rather research independently without agencies contacting you
honest_knock: It's genuinely free to submit a brief — but be clear on what it is: a lead-generation marketplace, not a neutral directory. Your brief goes straight to agencies who will reach out to pitch you, and providers pay to be visible and matched. It's a fast way to shortlist vetted agencies; just expect the outreach that comes with it.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 and again on 2026-10-06, read in their own help centre) Free for buyers. Clutch's help centre describes the Project Brief as the buyer's route in, and the article on sending one states that Clutch recommends up to 9 service providers that best match your project requirements, with no fee named anywhere in that flow. Clutch is a B2B services marketplace — the providers being listed pay for visibility, the buyer does not, and the help centre says plainly that directory listings are sorted by sponsored providers and Clutch rank. A free provider profile covers the listing, client review collection, badges and widgets, contributed content, awards eligibility, up to 3 sharable case studies and a profile on sister-site The Manifest; Sponsorship, Featured Listings and Clutch Verified (previously Clutch+) are the paid upgrades on top.

compare_with.name: G2
compare_with.why: G2 and traditional directories make you scroll and compare yourself; Clutch's brief-matching narrows it to a handful of vetted providers fast — the trade-off is that it's a matching marketplace where you'll field agency outreach
